fish.top: In the beginning God created
fish.bot: the heaven and the earth.
fish.verse: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

fish.top: between thy seed and her seed;
fish.bot: it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
fish.verse: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.

fish.top: And Enoch walked with God:
fish.bot: and he was not; for God took him.
fish.verse: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.

fish.top: And the LORD said unto Noah,
fish.bot: Come thou and all thy house into the ark...
fish.verse: And the LORD said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.

fish.top: I do set my bow in the cloud,
fish.bot: and it shall be for a token of a covenant...
fish.verse: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

fish.top: Get thee out of thy country...
fish.bot: unto a land that I will shew thee:
fish.verse: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, unto a land that I will shew thee:

fish.top: Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield,
fish.bot: and thy exceeding great reward.
fish.verse: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.

fish.top: I am the Almighty God;
fish.bot: walk before me, and be thou perfect.
fish.verse: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.

fish.top: Shall not the Judge
fish.bot: of all the earth do right?
fish.verse: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?

fish.top: the men laid hold upon his hand...
fish.bot: the LORD being merciful unto him...
fish.verse: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.

fish.top: And the LORD visited Sarah
fish.bot: as he had said...
fish.verse: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.

fish.top: My son, God will provide
fish.bot: himself a lamb for a burnt offering...
fish.verse: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

fish.top: I being in the way,
fish.bot: the LORD led me...
fish.verse: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master’s brethren.

fish.top: For now the LORD hath made room for us,
fish.bot: and we shall be fruitful in the land.
fish.verse: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

fish.top: God give thee of the dew of heaven,
fish.bot: and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:
fish.verse: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:

fish.top: And, behold, I am with thee,
fish.bot: and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest...
fish.verse: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.

fish.top: And God remembered Rachel,
fish.bot: and God hearkened to her...
fish.verse: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

fish.top: The LORD watch between me and thee,
fish.bot: when we are absent one from another.
fish.verse: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.

fish.top: I will not let thee go,
fish.bot: except thou bless me.
fish.verse: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

fish.top: I will make there an altar unto God,
fish.bot: who answered me in the day of my distress...
fish.verse: And let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.

fish.top: Now these are the generations
fish.bot: of Esau, who is Edom.
fish.verse: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.

fish.top: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered
fish.bot: him out of their hands...
fish.verse: And Reuben heard it , and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.

fish.top: And Judah acknowledged them, and said,
fish.bot: She hath been more righteous than I...
fish.verse: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.

fish.top: And the LORD was with Joseph,
fish.bot: and he was a prosperous man...
fish.verse: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

fish.top: For God hath caused me to be fruitful
fish.bot: in the land of my affliction.
fish.verse: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.

fish.top: We are verily guilty concerning our brother,
fish.bot: in that we saw the anguish of his soul...
fish.verse: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.

fish.top: for his bowels did yearn upon his brother:
fish.bot: and he sought where to weep...
fish.verse: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.

fish.top: let thy servant abide instead of the lad
fish.bot: a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up...
fish.verse: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.

fish.top: ...for God did send me
fish.bot: before you to preserve life.
fish.verse: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.

fish.top: And Joseph nourished his father,
fish.bot: and his brethren, and all his father's household...
fish.verse: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father’s household, with bread, according to their families.

fish.top: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah...
fish.bot: until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering...
fish.verse: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.

fish.top: Ye thought evil against me;
fish.bot: but God meant it unto good...
fish.verse: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

fish.top: And I am come down to deliver them
fish.bot: out of the hand of the Egyptians...
fish.verse: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

fish.top: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth,
fish.bot: and teach thee what thou shalt say.
fish.verse: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.

fish.top: And I will take you to me for a people,
fish.bot: and I will be to you a God...
fish.verse: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

fish.top: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh,
fish.bot: This is the finger of God...
fish.verse: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This is the finger of God: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.

fish.top: ...that my name may be declared
fish.bot: throughout all the earth.
fish.verse: And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up, for to shew in thee my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.

fish.top: but all the children of Israel
fish.bot: had light in their dwellings.
fish.verse: They saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.

fish.top: and when I see the blood,
fish.bot: I will pass over you...
fish.verse: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.

fish.top: And the LORD went before them by day
fish.bot: in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way...
fish.verse: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:

fish.top: The LORD is my strength and song,
fish.bot: and he is become my salvation...
fish.verse: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

fish.top: It is manna... This is the bread
fish.bot: which the LORD hath given you to eat.
fish.verse: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat.

fish.top: Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands...
fish.bot: and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
fish.verse: But Moses’ hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.

fish.top: ...how I bare you on eagles' wings,
fish.bot: and brought you unto myself.
fish.verse: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles’ wings, and brought you unto myself.

fish.top: I love my master, my wife,
fish.bot: and my children; I will not go out free:
fish.verse: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:

fish.top: Behold, I send an Angel before thee,
fish.bot: to keep thee in the way...
fish.verse: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.

fish.top: And there I will meet with thee,
fish.bot: and I will commune with thee...
fish.verse: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.

fish.top: and the vail shall divide unto you
fish.bot: between the holy place and the most holy.
fish.verse: And thou shalt hang up the vail under the taches, that thou mayest bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.

fish.top: and Aaron shall bear their names
fish.bot: before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial.
fish.verse: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial.

fish.top: And they shall know
fish.bot: that I am the LORD their God...
fish.verse: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.

fish.top: I have filled him with the spirit of God,
fish.bot: in wisdom... and in all manner of workmanship...
fish.verse: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,

fish.top: Who is on the LORD's side?
fish.bot: let him come unto me...
fish.verse: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD’s side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.

fish.top: My presence shall go with thee,
fish.bot: and I will give thee rest.
fish.verse: And he said, My presence shall go with thee , and I will give thee rest.

fish.top: ...every one whom his spirit made willing,
fish.bot: and they brought the LORD's offering...
fish.verse: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the LORD’s offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.

fish.top: And he made the holy anointing oil,
fish.bot: and the pure incense of sweet spices...
fish.verse: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.

fish.top: and, behold, they had done it
fish.bot: as the LORD had commanded... and Moses blessed them.
fish.verse: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.

fish.top: Then a cloud covered the tent...
fish.bot: and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
fish.verse: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

fish.top: neither shalt thou suffer the salt
fish.bot: of the covenant of thy God to be lacking...
fish.verse: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.

fish.top: ...the priest shall make an atonement for him,
fish.bot: and it shall be forgiven him.
fish.verse: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD ; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.

fish.top: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar;
fish.bot: it shall never go out.
fish.verse: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.

fish.top: If he offer it for a thanksgiving,
fish.bot: then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving...
fish.verse: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.

fish.top: And he poured of the anointing oil
fish.bot: upon Aaron's head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
fish.verse: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

fish.top: when all the people saw,
fish.bot: they shouted, and fell on their faces.
fish.verse: And there came a fire out from before the LORD, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.

fish.top: For I am the LORD your God...
fish.bot: ye shall be holy; for I am holy...
fish.verse: For I am the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

fish.top: he shall pronounce him clean...
fish.bot: it is all turned white: he is clean.
fish.verse: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.

fish.top: and shall pronounce him clean,
fish.bot: and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.
fish.verse: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.

fish.top: and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh
fish.bot: in running water, and shall be clean.
fish.verse: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

fish.top: ...to cleanse you, that ye may be clean
fish.bot: from all your sins before the LORD.
fish.verse: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD .

fish.top: For the life of the flesh is in the blood:
fish.bot: ...it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.
fish.verse: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.

fish.top: But the stranger that dwelleth with you...
fish.bot: thou shalt love him as thyself...
fish.verse: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.

fish.top: I the LORD am holy, and have severed you
fish.bot: from other people, that ye should be mine.
fish.verse: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the LORD am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.

fish.top: I will be hallowed among the children of Israel:
fish.bot: I am the LORD which hallow you,
fish.verse: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the LORD which hallow you,

fish.top: ...the seventh day is the sabbath of rest,
fish.bot: an holy convocation...
fish.verse: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.

fish.top: ...and proclaim liberty throughout all the land
fish.bot: unto all the inhabitants thereof...
fish.verse: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.

fish.top: And I will give peace in the land,
fish.bot: and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid...
fish.verse: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

fish.top: And all the tithe of the land...
fish.bot: is the LORD's: it is holy unto the LORD.
fish.verse: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD’s: it is holy unto the LORD.

fish.top: Take ye the sum of all the congregation...
fish.bot: with the number of their names...
fish.verse: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;

fish.top: Every man... shall pitch by his own standard...
fish.bot: about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.
fish.verse: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father’s house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.

fish.top: Because all the firstborn are mine...
fish.bot: mine shall they be: I am the LORD.
fish.verse: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the LORD.

fish.top: every one according to his service,
fish.bot: and according to his burden...
fish.verse: According to the commandment of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the LORD commanded Moses.

fish.top: The LORD bless thee,
fish.bot: and keep thee.
fish.verse: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:

fish.top: then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him
fish.bot: from off the mercy seat... and he spake unto him.
fish.verse: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.

fish.top: At the commandment of the LORD
fish.bot: the children of Israel journeyed...
fish.verse: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.

fish.top: come thou with us, and we will do thee good:
fish.bot: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.
fish.verse: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses’ father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the LORD said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.

fish.top: Is the LORD's hand waxed short?
fish.bot: thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass...
fish.verse: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD’s hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.

fish.top: Now the man Moses was very meek,
fish.bot: above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.
fish.verse: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)

fish.top: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us
fish.bot: into this land... which floweth with milk and honey.
fish.verse: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.

fish.top: that ye may look upon it,
fish.bot: and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them...
fish.verse: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:

fish.top: And he stood between the dead and the living;
fish.bot: and the plague was stayed.
fish.verse: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

fish.top: ...the rod of Aaron...
fish.bot: was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms...
fish.verse: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.

fish.top: and with his rod he smote the rock twice:
fish.bot: and the water came out abundantly...
fish.verse: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.

fish.top: ...every one that is bitten,
fish.bot: when he looketh upon it, shall live.
fish.verse: And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.

fish.top: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam,
fish.bot: and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way...
fish.verse: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.

fish.top: hath he said, and shall he not do it?
fish.bot: or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
fish.verse: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?

fish.top: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob...
fish.bot: as gardens by the river's side...
fish.verse: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel! As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river’s side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.

fish.top: And there was not left a man of them,
fish.bot: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
fish.verse: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

fish.top: ...that the congregation of the LORD
fish.bot: be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
fish.verse: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.

fish.top: If a man vow a vow unto the LORD...
fish.bot: he shall not break his word...
fish.verse: If a man vow a vow unto the LORD , or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.

fish.top: Every thing that may abide the fire,
fish.bot: ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean...
fish.verse: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.

fish.top: Save Caleb... and Joshua the son of Nun:
fish.bot: for they have wholly followed the LORD.
fish.verse: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.

fish.top: And Moses wrote their goings out
fish.bot: according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD...
fish.verse: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.

fish.top: ...cities of refuge for you;
fish.bot: that the slayer may flee thither...
fish.verse: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.

fish.top: ...the LORD thy God bare thee,
fish.bot: as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went...
fish.verse: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.

fish.top: these forty years the LORD thy God
fish.bot: hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.
fish.verse: For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.

fish.top: But charge Joshua, and encourage him,
fish.bot: and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people...
fish.verse: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.

fish.top: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God,
fish.bot: thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart...
fish.verse: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.

fish.top: Hear, O Israel:
fish.bot: The LORD our God is one LORD:
fish.verse: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD :

fish.top: ...man doth not live by bread only,
fish.bot: but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD...
fish.verse: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.

fish.top: the LORD was wroth against you to destroy you.
fish.bot: But the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also.
fish.verse: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the LORD was wroth against you to destroy you. But the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also.

fish.top: And ye shall teach them your children,
fish.bot: speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house...
fish.verse: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

fish.top: Ye shall walk after the LORD your God,
fish.bot: ...and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.
fish.verse: Ye shall walk after the LORD your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.

fish.top: Thou shalt open thine hand wide
fish.bot: unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy...
fish.verse: For the poor shall never cease out of the land: therefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy, in thy land.

fish.top: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast
fish.bot: ...therefore thou shalt surely rejoice.
fish.verse: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD shall choose: because the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase, and in all the works of thine hands, therefore thou shalt surely rejoice.

fish.top: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet
fish.bot: ...unto him ye shall hearken;
fish.verse: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;

fish.top: For the LORD your God is he that goeth with you,
fish.bot: to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.
fish.verse: For the LORD your God is he that goeth with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.

fish.top: ...thou shalt surely help him
fish.bot: to lift them up again.
fish.verse: Thou shalt not see thy brother’s ass or his ox fall down by the way, and hide thyself from them: thou shalt surely help him to lift them up again.

fish.top: ...it shall be for the stranger,
fish.bot: for the fatherless, and for the widow...
fish.verse: When thou cuttest down thine harvest in thy field, and hast forgot a sheaf in the field, thou shalt not go again to fetch it: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow: that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hands.

fish.top: And when we cried unto the LORD...
fish.bot: the LORD heard our voice, and looked on our affliction...
fish.verse: And when we cried unto the LORD God of our fathers, the LORD heard our voice, and looked on our affliction, and our labour, and our oppression:

fish.top: And all these blessings shall come on thee,
fish.bot: and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice...
fish.verse: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.

fish.top: The secret things belong unto the LORD our God:
fish.bot: but those things which are revealed belong unto us...
fish.verse: The secret things belong unto the LORD our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.

fish.top: he will be with thee, he will not fail thee,
fish.bot: neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
fish.verse: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.

fish.top: As an eagle stirreth up her nest,
fish.bot: ...spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them...
fish.verse: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:

fish.top: The eternal God is thy refuge,
fish.bot: and underneath are the everlasting arms...
fish.verse: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them .

fish.top: Be strong and of a good courage;
fish.bot: ...the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
fish.verse: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

fish.top: Sanctify yourselves:
fish.bot: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.
fish.verse: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.

fish.top: Joshua said unto the people, Shout;
fish.bot: for the LORD hath given you the city.
fish.verse: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for the LORD hath given you the city.

fish.top: My son, give, I pray thee, glory to the LORD...
fish.bot: and make confession unto him... hide it not from me.
fish.verse: And Joshua said unto Achan, My son, give, I pray thee, glory to the LORD God of Israel, and make confession unto him; and tell me now what thou hast done; hide it not from me.

fish.top: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded,
fish.bot: which Joshua read not before all the congregation...
fish.verse: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.

fish.top: And now, behold, we are in thine hand:
fish.bot: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.
fish.verse: And now, behold, we are in thine hand: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.

fish.top: ...the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man:
fish.bot: for the LORD fought for Israel.
fish.verse: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the LORD fought for Israel.

fish.top: ...so did Joshua; he left nothing undone
fish.bot: of all that the LORD commanded Moses.
fish.verse: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.

fish.top: Now therefore give me this mountain...
fish.bot: if so be the LORD will be with me...
fish.verse: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the LORD will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.

fish.top: Give me a blessing... give me also springs of water.
fish.bot: And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.
fish.verse: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.

fish.top: How long are ye slack to go to possess the land,
fish.bot: which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?
fish.verse: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?

fish.top: ...and they shall be your refuge
fish.bot: from the avenger of blood.
fish.verse: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

fish.top: There failed not ought of any good thing
fish.bot: which the LORD had spoken... all came to pass.
fish.verse: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.

fish.top: ...called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness
fish.bot: between us that the LORD is God.
fish.verse: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that the LORD is God.

fish.top: ...choose you this day whom ye will serve;
fish.bot: ...as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
fish.verse: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD , choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD .

fish.top: ...the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying,
fish.bot: Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first...
fish.verse: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?

fish.top: ...then the LORD was with the judge,
fish.bot: ...for it repented the LORD because of their groanings...
fish.verse: And when the LORD raised them up judges, then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the LORD because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.

fish.top: But let them that love him be as the sun
fish.bot: when he goeth forth in his might.
fish.verse: So let all thine enemies perish, O LORD: but let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.

fish.top: ...The LORD is with thee,
fish.bot: thou mighty man of valour.
fish.verse: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.

fish.top: ...and they cried,
fish.bot: The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.
fish.verse: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.

fish.top: I will not rule over you...
fish.bot: the LORD shall rule over you.
fish.verse: And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: the LORD shall rule over you.

fish.top: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave
fish.bot: my fatness, wherewith by me they honour God and man...
fish.verse: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me they honour God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?

fish.top: And they put away the strange gods from among them,
fish.bot: and served the LORD...
fish.verse: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.

fish.top: O my Lord... come again unto us,
fish.bot: and teach us what we shall do...
fish.verse: Then Manoah intreated the LORD , and said, O my Lord, let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.

fish.top: ...and when he had drunk,
fish.bot: his spirit came again, and he revived...
fish.verse: But God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: wherefore he called the name thereof En-hakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.

fish.top: O Lord GOD, remember me, I pray thee,
fish.bot: and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once...
fish.verse: And Samson called unto the LORD , and said, O Lord GOD , remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.

fish.top: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace:
fish.bot: before the LORD is your way wherein ye go.
fish.verse: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace: before the LORD is your way wherein ye go.

fish.top: And the old man said, Peace be with thee;
fish.bot: howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me...
fish.verse: And the old man said, Peace be with thee; howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me; only lodge not in the street.

fish.top: ...and came unto the house of God, and wept,
fish.bot: and sat there before the LORD...
fish.verse: Then all the children of Israel, and all the people, went up, and came unto the house of God, and wept, and sat there before the LORD, and fasted that day until even, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.

fish.top: ...whither thou goest, I will go;
fish.bot: ...thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:
fish.verse: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

fish.top: spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid;
fish.bot: for thou art a near kinsman.
fish.verse: And he said, Who art thou? And she answered, I am Ruth thine handmaid: spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid; for thou art a near kinsman.

fish.top: If thou wilt redeem it, redeem it:
fish.bot: ...And he said, I will redeem it.
fish.verse: And I thought to advertise thee, saying, Buy it before the inhabitants, and before the elders of my people. If thou wilt redeem it , redeem it: but if thou wilt not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know: for there is none to redeem it beside thee; and I am after thee. And he said, I will redeem it .

fish.top: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust,
fish.bot: and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill...
fish.verse: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill, to set them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory: for the pillars of the earth are the LORD’s, and he hath set the world upon them.

fish.top: Then Samuel answered,
fish.bot: Speak; for thy servant heareth.
fish.verse: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.

fish.top: ...behold, Dagon was fallen upon his face
fish.bot: to the earth before the ark of the LORD.
fish.verse: And when they of Ashdod arose early on the morrow, behold, Dagon was fallen upon his face to the earth before the ark of the LORD. And they took Dagon, and set him in his place again.

fish.top: ...and called the name of it Eben-ezer,
fish.bot: saying, Hitherto hath the LORD helped us.
fish.verse: Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpeh and Shen, and called the name of it Eben-ezer, saying, Hitherto hath the LORD helped us.

fish.top: but stand thou still a while,
fish.bot: that I may shew thee the word of God.
fish.verse: And as they were going down to the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, Bid the servant pass on before us, (and he passed on,) but stand thou still a while, that I may shew thee the word of God.

fish.top: ...when he had turned his back to go from Samuel,
fish.bot: God gave him another heart...
fish.verse: And it was so, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart: and all those signs came to pass that day.

fish.top: Only fear the LORD, and serve him in truth...
fish.bot: for consider how great things he hath done for you.
fish.verse: Only fear the LORD , and serve him in truth with all your heart: for consider how great things he hath done for you.

fish.top: it may be that the LORD will work for us:
fish.bot: for there is no restraint to the LORD to save...
fish.verse: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that the LORD will work for us: for there is no restraint to the LORD to save by many or by few.

fish.top: ...for man looketh on the outward appearance,
fish.bot: but the LORD looketh on the heart.
fish.verse: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the Lord seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.

fish.top: ...for the battle is the LORD’s,
fish.bot: and he will give you into our hands.
fish.verse: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD’s , and he will give you into our hands.

fish.top: the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David
fish.bot: and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
fish.verse: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

fish.top: ...The LORD be between me and thee,
fish.bot: and between my seed and thy seed for ever.
fish.verse: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD, saying, The LORD be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city. be witness of that which etc

fish.top: And every one that was in distress... gathered
fish.bot: themselves unto him; and he became a captain over them...
fish.verse: And every one that was in distress, and every one that was in debt, and every one that was discontented, gathered themselves unto him; and he became a captain over them: and there were with him about four hundred men.

fish.top: And Jonathan Saul’s son arose,
fish.bot: and went to David... and strengthened his hand in God.
fish.verse: And Jonathan Saul’s son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.

fish.top: And blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou,
fish.bot: which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood...
fish.verse: And blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou, which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood, and from avenging myself with mine own hand.

fish.top: The LORD render to every man his righteousness
fish.bot: and his faithfulness...
fish.verse: The LORD render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness: for the LORD delivered thee into my hand to day, but I would not stretch forth mine hand against the LORD’s anointed.

fish.top: Surely, as the LORD liveth, thou hast been upright,
fish.bot: and thy going out and thy coming in... is good in my sight...
fish.verse: Then Achish called David, and said unto him, Surely, as the LORD liveth, thou hast been upright, and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host is good in my sight: for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day: nevertheless the lords favour thee not.

fish.top: ...thou shalt surely overtake them,
fish.bot: and without fail recover all.
fish.verse: And David enquired at the LORD , saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? And he answered him, Pursue: for thou shalt surely overtake them , and without fail recover all .

fish.top: And now the LORD shew kindness
fish.bot: and truth unto you...
fish.verse: And now the LORD shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.

fish.top: ...but David waxed stronger and stronger,
fish.bot: and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.
fish.verse: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.

fish.top: and the LORD said to thee,
fish.bot: Thou shalt feed my people Israel...
fish.verse: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over Israel.

fish.top: And thine house and thy kingdom
fish.bot: shall be established for ever before thee...
fish.verse: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.

fish.top: Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness
fish.bot: ...and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.
fish.verse: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father’s sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.

fish.top: Be of good courage, and let us play the men
fish.bot: ...and the LORD do that which seemeth him good.
fish.verse: Be of good courage, and let us play the men for our people, and for the cities of our God: and the LORD do that which seemeth him good.

fish.top: I have sinned against the LORD.
fish.bot: ...hath put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.
fish.verse: And David said unto Nathan, I have sinned against the LORD . And Nathan said unto David, The LORD also hath put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.

fish.top: And the soul of king David longed
fish.bot: to go forth unto Absalom...
fish.verse: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead.

fish.top: yet doth he devise means,
fish.bot: that his banished be not expelled from him.
fish.verse: For we must needs die, and are as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither doth God respect any person: yet doth he devise means, that his banished be not expelled from him.

fish.top: ...behold, here am I,
fish.bot: let him do to me as seemeth good unto him.
fish.verse: But if he thus say, I have no delight in thee; behold, here am I, let him do to me as seemeth good unto him.

fish.top: It may be that the LORD will look on mine affliction
fish.bot: and that the LORD will requite me good for his cursing...
fish.verse: It may be that the LORD will look on mine affliction, and that the LORD will requite me good for his cursing this day.

fish.top: ...O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom!
fish.bot: would God I had died for thee...
fish.verse: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had died for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!

fish.top: Therefore the king said unto Shimei,
fish.bot: Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.
fish.verse: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.

fish.top: And Rizpah... took sackcloth, and spread it
fish.bot: for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest...
fish.verse: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.

fish.top: ...The LORD is my rock,
fish.bot: and my fortress, and my deliverer;
fish.verse: And he said, The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;

fish.top: ...neither will I offer burnt offerings
fish.bot: unto the LORD my God of that which doth cost me nothing.
fish.verse: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the LORD my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

fish.top: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which hath given
fish.bot: one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.
fish.verse: And also thus said the king, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.

fish.top: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God,
fish.bot: to walk in his ways...
fish.verse: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:

fish.top: Give therefore thy servant
fish.bot: an understanding heart...
fish.verse: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?

fish.top: ...I purpose to build an house
fish.bot: unto the name of the LORD my God...
fish.verse: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.

fish.top: And I will dwell among the children of Israel,
fish.bot: and will not forsake my people Israel.
fish.verse: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.

fish.top: ...he set up the right pillar, and called...
fish.bot: ...the name thereof Jachin... the left pillar... Boaz.
fish.verse: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.

fish.top: ...there hath not failed one word
fish.bot: of all his good promise...
fish.verse: Blessed be the LORD , that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.

fish.top: I have hallowed this house... to put my name
fish.bot: there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart...
fish.verse: And the LORD said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

fish.top: ...if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command
fish.bot: thee, and wilt walk in my ways... I will be with thee...
fish.verse: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.

fish.top: If thou wilt be a servant unto this people...
fish.bot: then they will be thy servants for ever.
fish.verse: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.

fish.top: Intreat now the face of the LORD thy God,
fish.bot: ...and the king's hand was restored him again...
fish.verse: And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Intreat now the face of the LORD thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God besought the LORD, and the king’s hand was restored him again, and became as it was before., and: Heb. the face of the LORD, etc

fish.top: ...my servant David, who kept my commandments,
fish.bot: and who followed me with all his heart...
fish.verse: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee: and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in mine eyes;

fish.top: ...nevertheless Asa's heart was perfect
fish.bot: with the LORD all his days.
fish.verse: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa’s heart was perfect with the LORD all his days.

fish.top: And the barrel of meal wasted not,
fish.bot: neither did the cruse of oil fail...
fish.verse: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.

fish.top: Then the fire of the LORD fell,
fish.bot: and consumed the burnt sacrifice...
fish.verse: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.

fish.top: ...and after the fire
fish.bot: a still small voice.
fish.verse: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.

fish.top: ...The LORD is God of the hills, but he is not
fish.bot: God of the valleys... ye shall know that I am the LORD.
fish.verse: And there came a man of God, and spake unto the king of Israel, and said, Thus saith the LORD, Because the Syrians have said, The LORD is God of the hills, but he is not God of the valleys, therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand, and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

fish.top: ...because he humbleth himself before me,
fish.bot: I will not bring the evil in his days...
fish.verse: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days: but in his son’s days will I bring the evil upon his house.

fish.top: Enquire, I pray thee,
fish.bot: at the word of the LORD to day.
fish.verse: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.

fish.top: ...I pray thee, let a double portion
fish.bot: of thy spirit be upon me.
fish.verse: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.

fish.top: ...Make this valley full of ditches.
fish.bot: ...yet that valley shall be filled with water...
fish.verse: And he said, Thus saith the LORD, Make this valley full of ditches. For thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that ye may drink, both ye, and your cattle, and your beasts.

fish.top: ...There is not a vessel more.
fish.bot: And the oil stayed.
fish.verse: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.

fish.top: ...his flesh came again like unto the flesh
fish.bot: of a little child, and he was clean.
fish.verse: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

fish.top: ...LORD, I pray thee, open his eyes,
fish.bot: that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes...
fish.verse: And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD , I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.

fish.top: ...this day is a day of good tidings,
fish.bot: ...come, that we may go and tell the king's household.
fish.verse: Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day is a day of good tidings, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and tell the king’s household.

fish.top: ...Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits
fish.bot: of the field since the day that she left the land...
fish.verse: And when the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed unto her a certain officer, saying, Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.

fish.top: ...This is the word of the LORD, which he spake
fish.bot: by his servant Elijah the Tishbite...
fish.verse: Wherefore they came again, and told him. And he said, This is the word of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:

fish.top: ...Is thine heart right, as my heart is with
fish.bot: thy heart?... If it be, give me thine hand.
fish.verse: And when he was departed thence, he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him: and he saluted him, and said to him, Is thine heart right, as my heart is with thy heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it be, give me thine hand. And he gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.

fish.top: And Jehoiada made a covenant...
fish.bot: that they should be the LORD’s people...
fish.verse: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people, that they should be the LORD’s people; between the king also and the people.

fish.top: And the LORD was gracious unto them,
fish.bot: and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them...
fish.verse: And the LORD was gracious unto them, and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither cast he them from his presence as yet.

fish.top: ...He built the higher gate
fish.bot: of the house of the LORD.
fish.verse: Howbeit the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places. He built the higher gate of the house of the LORD.

fish.top: But the LORD your God ye shall fear;
fish.bot: and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.
fish.verse: But the LORD your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.

fish.top: For he clave to the LORD,
fish.bot: and departed not from following him...
fish.verse: For he clave to the LORD , and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.

fish.top: ...Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD,
fish.bot: and spread it before the LORD.
fish.verse: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.

fish.top: I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears:
fish.bot: behold, I will heal thee...
fish.verse: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD , the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the LORD .

fish.top: ...I have found the book of the law
fish.bot: in the house of the LORD...
fish.verse: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

fish.top: ...that turned to the LORD with all his heart,
fish.bot: and with all his soul, and with all his might...
fish.verse: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.

fish.top: ...did lift up the head of Jehoiachin
fish.bot: king of Judah out of prison;
fish.verse: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;

fish.top: Abram;
fish.bot: the same is Abraham.
fish.verse: Abram; the same is Abraham.

fish.top: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
fish.bot: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,
fish.verse: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz, And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,

fish.top: ...Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed,
fish.bot: and enlarge my coast... that thine hand might be with me...
fish.verse: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.

fish.top: ...David set over the service of song
fish.bot: in the house of the LORD...
fish.verse: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD , after that the ark had rest.

fish.top: And Ephraim their father mourned many days,
fish.bot: and his brethren came to comfort him.
fish.verse: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.

fish.top: And they lodged round about the house of God,
fish.bot: ...and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.
fish.verse: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.

fish.top: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would
fish.bot: give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem...
fish.verse: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem, that is at the gate!

fish.top: ...men that had understanding of the times,
fish.bot: to know what Israel ought to do...
fish.verse: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.

fish.top: ...the singers with instruments of musick,
fish.bot: psalteries and harps... lifting up the voice with joy.
fish.verse: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.

fish.top: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good;
fish.bot: for his mercy endureth for ever.
fish.verse: O give thanks unto the LORD ; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

fish.top: ...Thus the LORD preserved David
fish.bot: whithersoever he went.
fish.verse: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David’s servants. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

fish.top: ...I will not take that which is thine for the LORD,
fish.bot: nor offer burnt offerings without cost.
fish.verse: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is thine for the LORD, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.

fish.top: And to stand every morning
fish.bot: to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at even;
fish.verse: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD , and likewise at even;

fish.top: ...who prophesied with a harp,
fish.bot: to give thanks and to praise the LORD.
fish.verse: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD.

fish.top: ...the divisions of the porters,
fish.bot: ...to minister in the house of the LORD.
fish.verse: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the LORD.

fish.top: ...know thou the God of thy father,
fish.bot: and serve him with a perfect heart...
fish.verse: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.

fish.top: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power,
fish.bot: and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty...
fish.verse: Thine, O LORD , is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O LORD , and thou art exalted as head above all.

fish.top: ...seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens
fish.bot: cannot contain him?...
fish.verse: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?

fish.top: ...the trumpeters and singers were as one,
fish.bot: to make one sound to be heard in praising... the LORD...
fish.verse: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised the LORD, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: that then the house was filled with a cloud, even the house of the LORD;

fish.top: ...let thy priests, O LORD God, be clothed
fish.bot: with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.
fish.verse: Now therefore arise, O LORD God, into thy resting place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.

fish.top: If my people... shall humble themselves, and pray,
fish.bot: ...then will I hear from heaven... and will heal their land.
fish.verse: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

fish.top: ...because thy God loved Israel,
fish.bot: ...to do judgment and justice.
fish.verse: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for the LORD thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.

fish.top: ...They have humbled themselves; therefore
fish.bot: I will not destroy them, but I will grant them...
fish.verse: And when the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

fish.top: ...for we rest on thee,
fish.bot: and in thy name we go against this multitude...
fish.verse: And Asa cried unto the LORD his God, and said, LORD , it is nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O LORD our God; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O LORD , thou art our God; let not man prevail against thee.

fish.top: ...let not your hands be weak:
fish.bot: for your work shall be rewarded.
fish.verse: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.

fish.top: ...for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God,
fish.bot: nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.
fish.verse: Wherefore now let the fear of the LORD be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.

fish.top: ...neither know we what to do:
fish.bot: but our eyes are upon thee.
fish.verse: O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee.

fish.top: ...Jehoshabeath... took Joash the son of Ahaziah,
fish.bot: ...hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.
fish.verse: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king’s sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.

fish.top: And it came to pass after this, that Joash
fish.bot: was minded to repair the house of the LORD.
fish.verse: And it came to pass after this, that Joash was minded to repair the house of the LORD.

fish.top: ...as long as he sought the LORD,
fish.bot: God made him to prosper.
fish.verse: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God: and as long as he sought the LORD , God made him to prosper.

fish.top: ...with the spoil clothed all that were naked
fish.bot: ...and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them...
fish.verse: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.

fish.top: ...when the burnt offering began, the song
fish.bot: of the LORD began also with the trumpets...
fish.verse: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD began also with the trumpets, and with the instruments ordained by David king of Israel.

fish.top: ...the LORD your God is gracious and merciful,
fish.bot: and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.
fish.verse: For if ye turn again unto the LORD , your brethren and your children shall find compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for the LORD your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.

fish.top: ...but with us is the LORD our God
fish.bot: to help us, and to fight our battles...
fish.verse: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

fish.top: And when he was in affliction, he besought
fish.bot: the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly...
fish.verse: And when he was in affliction, he besought the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers,

fish.top: ...while he was yet young, he began to seek
fish.bot: after the God of David his father...
fish.verse: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.

fish.top: Moreover Josiah kept a passover
fish.bot: unto the LORD in Jerusalem...
fish.verse: Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto the LORD in Jerusalem: and they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

fish.top: ...all them whose spirit God had raised,
fish.bot: to go up to build the house of the LORD...
fish.verse: Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all them whose spirit God had raised, to go up to build the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem.

fish.top: ...and came again unto Jerusalem and Judah,
fish.bot: every one unto his city;
fish.verse: Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity, of those which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and came again unto Jerusalem and Judah, every one unto his city;

fish.top: ...all the people shouted with a great shout,
fish.bot: when they praised the LORD...
fish.verse: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto the LORD ; because he is good, for his mercy endureth for ever toward Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the LORD , because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid.

fish.top: ...the children of the captivity, kept
fish.bot: the dedication of this house of God with joy,
fish.verse: And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy,

fish.top: For Ezra had prepared his heart
fish.bot: to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it...
fish.verse: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD , and to do it , and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.

fish.top: So we fasted and besought our God for this:
fish.bot: and he was intreated of us.
fish.verse: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.

fish.top: ...grace hath been shewed from the LORD our God,
fish.bot: to leave us a remnant to escape...
fish.verse: And now for a little space grace hath been shewed from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.

fish.top: The God of heaven, he will prosper us;
fish.bot: therefore we his servants will arise and build...
fish.verse: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.

fish.top: ...resort ye thither unto us:
fish.bot: our God shall fight for us.
fish.verse: In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.

fish.top: ...I am doing a great work,
fish.bot: so that I cannot come down...
fish.verse: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?

fish.top: And my God put into mine heart
fish.bot: to gather together the nobles, and the rulers...
fish.verse: And my God put into mine heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first, and found written therein,

fish.top: ...neither be ye sorry;
fish.bot: for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
fish.verse: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

fish.top: Yet many years didst thou forbear them...
fish.bot: ...for thou art a gracious and merciful God.
fish.verse: Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands. Nevertheless for thy great mercies’ sake thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for thou art a gracious and merciful God.

fish.top: And the people blessed all the men,
fish.bot: that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.
fish.verse: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.

fish.top: ...God had made them rejoice with great joy...
fish.bot: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.
fish.verse: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.

fish.top: ...howbeit our God turned
fish.bot: the curse into a blessing.
fish.verse: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.

fish.top: ...whom Mordecai, when her father and mother
fish.bot: were dead, took for his own daughter.
fish.verse: And he brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther, his uncle’s daughter: for she had neither father nor mother, and the maid was fair and beautiful; whom Mordecai, when her father and mother were dead, took for his own daughter.
