fish.top: ...who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom
fish.bot: for such a time as this?
fish.verse: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father’s house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?

fish.top: ...she obtained favour in his sight:
fish.bot: and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre...
fish.verse: And it was so, when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, that she obtained favour in his sight: and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand. So Esther drew near, and touched the top of the sceptre.

fish.top: The Jews had light,
fish.bot: and gladness, and joy, and honour.
fish.verse: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.

fish.top: ...the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away;
fish.bot: blessed be the name of the LORD.
fish.verse: And said, Naked came I out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD .

fish.top: I would seek unto God,
fish.bot: and unto God would I commit my cause...
fish.verse: I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:

fish.top: Though thy beginning was small,
fish.bot: yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
fish.verse: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.

fish.top: Thine hands have made me
fish.bot: and fashioned me together round about...
fish.verse: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.

fish.top: With him is wisdom and strength,
fish.bot: he hath counsel and understanding.
fish.verse: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.

fish.top: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven,
fish.bot: and my record is on high.
fish.verse: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.

fish.top: For I know that my redeemer liveth,
fish.bot: and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth.
fish.verse: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

fish.top: But he knoweth the way that I take:
fish.bot: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
fish.verse: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

fish.top: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place,
fish.bot: and hangeth the earth upon nothing.
fish.verse: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.

fish.top: ...Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom;
fish.bot: and to depart from evil is understanding.
fish.verse: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.

fish.top: But there is a spirit in man:
fish.bot: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
fish.verse: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.

fish.top: Deliver him from going down to the pit:
fish.bot: I have found a ransom.
fish.verse: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.

fish.top: If they obey and serve him,
fish.bot: they shall spend their days in prosperity...
fish.verse: If they obey and serve him , they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

fish.top: When the morning stars sang together,
fish.bot: and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
fish.verse: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

fish.top: I know that thou canst do every thing,
fish.bot: and that no thought can be withholden from thee.
fish.verse: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.

fish.top: But his delight is in the law of the LORD;
fish.bot: and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
fish.verse: But his delight is in the law of the LORD ; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

fish.top: And they that know thy name
fish.bot: will put their trust in thee...
fish.verse: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD , hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

fish.top: The words of the LORD are pure words:
fish.bot: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
fish.verse: The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

fish.top: The heavens declare the glory of God;
fish.bot: and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
fish.verse: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

fish.top: The LORD is my shepherd;
fish.bot: I shall not want.
fish.verse: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

fish.top: The LORD is my light and my salvation;
fish.bot: whom shall I fear?
fish.verse: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

fish.top: ...weeping may endure for a night,
fish.bot: but joy cometh in the morning.
fish.verse: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

fish.top: O taste and see that the LORD is good:
fish.bot: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
fish.verse: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

fish.top: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD:
fish.bot: and he delighteth in his way.
fish.verse: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.

fish.top: And he hath put a new song in my mouth,
fish.bot: even praise unto our God...
fish.verse: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it , and fear, and shall trust in the LORD .

fish.top: Be still, and know that I am God:
fish.bot: I will be exalted among the heathen...
fish.verse: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

fish.top: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean:
fish.bot: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
fish.verse: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

fish.top: Cast thy burden upon the LORD,
fish.bot: and he shall sustain thee...
fish.verse: Cast thy burden upon the LORD , and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

fish.top: ...yea, in the shadow of thy wings
fish.bot: will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
fish.verse: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.

fish.top: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee:
fish.bot: my soul thirsteth for thee...
fish.verse: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

fish.top: A father of the fatherless,
fish.bot: and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
fish.verse: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

fish.top: My flesh and my heart faileth:
fish.bot: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
fish.verse: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

fish.top: I will meditate also of all thy work,
fish.bot: and talk of thy doings.
fish.verse: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.

fish.top: But made his own people to go forth like sheep,
fish.bot: and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
fish.verse: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

fish.top: I am the LORD thy God...
fish.bot: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
fish.verse: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

fish.top: Wilt thou not revive us again:
fish.bot: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
fish.verse: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

fish.top: I will say of the LORD,
fish.bot: He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
fish.verse: I will say of the LORD , He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

fish.top: O come, let us worship and bow down:
fish.bot: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
fish.verse: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

fish.top: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving,
fish.bot: and into his courts with praise...
fish.verse: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

fish.top: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name:
fish.bot: make known his deeds among the people.
fish.verse: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

fish.top: For he satisfieth the longing soul,
fish.bot: and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
fish.verse: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

fish.top: He sent redemption unto his people:
fish.bot: he hath commanded his covenant for ever...
fish.verse: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.

fish.top: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust,
fish.bot: and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill...
fish.verse: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

fish.top: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet,
fish.bot: and a light unto my path.
fish.verse: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

fish.top: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills,
fish.bot: from whence cometh my help.
fish.verse: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

fish.top: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is
fish.bot: for brethren to dwell together in unity!
fish.verse: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

fish.top: I will praise thee;
fish.bot: for I am fearfully and wonderfully made...
fish.verse: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

fish.top: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God:
fish.bot: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
fish.verse: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

fish.top: Let every thing that hath breath
fish.bot: praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
fish.verse: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD . Praise ye the LORD .

fish.top: In all thy ways acknowledge him,
fish.bot: and he shall direct thy paths.
fish.verse: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

fish.top: Go to the ant, thou sluggard;
fish.bot: consider her ways, and be wise...
fish.verse: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:

fish.top: Blessed is the man that heareth me,
fish.bot: watching daily at my gates...
fish.verse: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.

fish.top: The liberal soul shall be made fat:
fish.bot: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
fish.verse: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

fish.top: A soft answer turneth away wrath:
fish.bot: but grievous words stir up anger.
fish.verse: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

fish.top: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold!
fish.bot: and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
fish.verse: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!

fish.top: The name of the LORD is a strong tower:
fish.bot: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
fish.verse: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

fish.top: Train up a child in the way he should go:
fish.bot: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
fish.verse: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.

fish.top: My son, give me thine heart,
fish.bot: and let thine eyes observe my ways.
fish.verse: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.

fish.top: As cold waters to a thirsty soul,
fish.bot: so is good news from a far country.
fish.verse: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

fish.top: Iron sharpeneth iron;
fish.bot: so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
fish.verse: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

fish.top: Every word of God is pure:
fish.bot: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
fish.verse: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.

fish.top: To every thing there is a season,
fish.bot: and a time to every purpose under the heaven.
fish.verse: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:

fish.top: Two are better than one...
fish.bot: ...if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow...
fish.verse: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.

fish.top: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning...
fish.bot: ...the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
fish.verse: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.

fish.top: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do,
fish.bot: do it with thy might...
fish.verse: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.

fish.top: Remember now thy Creator
fish.bot: in the days of thy youth...
fish.verse: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;

fish.top: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine:
fish.bot: he feedeth among the lilies.
fish.verse: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine: he feedeth among the lilies.

fish.top: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD:
fish.bot: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow...
fish.verse: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD : though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

fish.top: they shall beat their swords into plowshares,
fish.bot: and their spears into pruninghooks...
fish.verse: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

fish.top: Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?
fish.bot: Then said I, Here am I; send me.
fish.verse: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.

fish.top: Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son,
fish.bot: and shall call his name Immanuel.
fish.verse: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

fish.top: ...and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor,
fish.bot: The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
fish.verse: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

fish.top: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water
fish.bot: out of the wells of salvation.
fish.verse: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.

fish.top: the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow,
fish.bot: and from thy fear...
fish.verse: And it shall come to pass in the day that the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,

fish.top: At that day shall a man look to his Maker,
fish.bot: and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.
fish.verse: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.

fish.top: And the key of the house of David...
fish.bot: ...so he shall open, and none shall shut...
fish.verse: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.

fish.top: They shall lift up their voice,
fish.bot: they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD...
fish.verse: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.

fish.top: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace,
fish.bot: whose mind is stayed on thee...
fish.verse: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

fish.top: Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone,
fish.bot: a tried stone, a precious corner stone...
fish.verse: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD , Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone , a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.

fish.top: In returning and rest shall ye be saved;
fish.bot: in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength...
fish.verse: For thus saith the Lord GOD , the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.

fish.top: ...as rivers of water in a dry place,
fish.bot: as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
fish.verse: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.

fish.top: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return,
fish.bot: and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy...
fish.verse: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

fish.top: Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD,
fish.bot: and spread it before the LORD.
fish.verse: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.

fish.top: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength;
fish.bot: they shall mount up with wings as eagles...
fish.verse: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

fish.top: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand,
fish.bot: saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
fish.verse: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.

fish.top: Fear not: for I have redeemed thee,
fish.bot: I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
fish.verse: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.

fish.top: And even to your old age I am he;
fish.bot: and even to hoar hairs will I carry you...
fish.verse: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you .

fish.top: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver;
fish.bot: I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
fish.verse: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.

fish.top: I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands;
fish.bot: thy walls are continually before me.
fish.verse: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.

fish.top: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet
fish.bot: of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace...
fish.verse: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!

fish.top: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters...
fish.bot: ...come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
fish.verse: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

fish.top: And the LORD shall guide thee continually,...
fish.bot: thou shalt be like a watered garden...
fish.verse: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.

fish.top: Arise, shine; for thy light is come,
fish.bot: and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
fish.verse: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.

fish.top: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory
fish.bot: in the hand of the LORD...
fish.verse: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD , and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

fish.top: But now, O LORD, thou art our father;
fish.bot: we are the clay, and thou our potter...
fish.verse: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.

fish.top: As one whom his mother comforteth,
fish.bot: so will I comfort you...
fish.verse: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.

fish.top: ...they have forsaken me
fish.bot: the fountain of living waters...
fish.verse: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.

fish.top: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart,
fish.bot: which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
fish.verse: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.

fish.top: ...ask for the old paths, where is the good way,
fish.bot: and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls.
fish.verse: Thus saith the LORD , Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein .

fish.top: Obey my voice, and I will be your God,
fish.bot: and ye shall be my people...
fish.verse: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.

fish.top: ...let him that glorieth glory in this,
fish.bot: that he understandeth and knoweth me...
fish.verse: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the LORD .

fish.top: If thou hast run with the footmen,
fish.bot: and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend...
fish.verse: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein thou trustedst, they wearied thee, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?

fish.top: ...yet thou, O LORD
fish.bot: art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name...
fish.verse: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonied, as a mighty man that cannot save? yet thou, O LORD , art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.

fish.top: Thy words were found, and I did eat them;
fish.bot: and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing...
fish.verse: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.

fish.top: Behold, as the clay is in the potter’s hand,
fish.bot: so are ye in mine hand...
fish.verse: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD . Behold, as the clay is in the potter’s hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.

fish.top: But his word was in mine heart
fish.bot: as a burning fire shut up in my bones...
fish.verse: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not stay.

fish.top: Behold, I set before you
fish.bot: the way of life, and the way of death.
fish.verse: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.

fish.top: ...I will raise unto David a righteous Branch,
fish.bot: and a King shall reign and prosper...
fish.verse: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.

fish.top: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good,
fish.bot: and I will bring them again to this land...
fish.verse: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.

fish.top: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings,
fish.bot: and obey the voice of the LORD your God...
fish.verse: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the LORD your God; and the LORD will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.

fish.top: I have made the earth... by my outstretched arm,
fish.bot: and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.
fish.verse: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that are upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.

fish.top: And ye shall seek me, and find me,
fish.bot: when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
fish.verse: And ye shall seek me, and find me , when ye shall search for me with all your heart.

fish.top: I will put my law in their inward parts,
fish.bot: and write it in their hearts...
fish.verse: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.

fish.top: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth...
fish.bot: ...there is nothing too hard for thee.
fish.verse: Ah Lord GOD ! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:

fish.top: Call unto me, and I will answer thee,
fish.bot: and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
fish.verse: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

fish.top: and had done right in my sight,
fish.bot: in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour...
fish.verse: And ye were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:

fish.top: Take thee again another roll,
fish.bot: and write in it all the former words...
fish.verse: Take thee again another roll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah hath burned.

fish.top: For I will surely deliver thee...
fish.bot: ...because thou hast put thy trust in me, saith the LORD.
fish.verse: For I will surely deliver thee, and thou shalt not fall by the sword, but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee: because thou hast put thy trust in me, saith the LORD .

fish.top: And now, behold, I loose thee this day
fish.bot: from the chains which were upon thine hand...
fish.verse: And now, behold, I loose thee this day from the chains which were upon thine hand. If it seem good unto thee to come with me into Babylon, come; and I will look well unto thee: but if it seem ill unto thee to come with me into Babylon, forbear: behold, all the land is before thee: whither it seemeth good and convenient for thee to go, thither go.

fish.top: ...then will I build you, and not pull you down,
fish.bot: and I will plant you, and not pluck you up...
fish.verse: If ye will still abide in this land, then will I build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up: for I repent me of the evil that I have done unto you.

fish.top: I sent unto you all my servants the prophets,
fish.bot: rising early and sending them...
fish.verse: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending them, saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing that I hate.

fish.top: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the LORD:
fish.bot: for I am with thee...
fish.verse: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the LORD : for I am with thee; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee: but I will not make a full end of thee, but correct thee in measure; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished.

fish.top: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab
fish.bot: in the latter days, saith the LORD...
fish.verse: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the LORD. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.

fish.top: Leave thy fatherless children,
fish.bot: I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.
fish.verse: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.

fish.top: ...the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for,
fish.bot: and there shall be none... for I will pardon them...
fish.verse: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD , the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.

fish.top: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness:
fish.bot: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.
fish.verse: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.

fish.top: And changed his prison garments:
fish.bot: and he did continually eat bread before him...
fish.verse: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.

fish.top: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by?
fish.bot: behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow...
fish.verse: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.

fish.top: ...his compassions fail not.
fish.bot: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
fish.verse: It is of the LORD’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

fish.top: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever;
fish.bot: thy throne from generation to generation.
fish.verse: Thou, O LORD , remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.

fish.top: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman
fish.bot: ...therefore hear the word at my mouth...
fish.verse: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.

fish.top: according to the number of the days
fish.bot: that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.
fish.verse: Lie thou also upon thy left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it: according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.

fish.top: Yet will I leave a remnant,
fish.bot: that ye may have some that shall escape the sword...
fish.verse: Yet will I leave a remnant, that ye may have some that shall escape the sword among the nations, when ye shall be scattered through the countries.

fish.top: and set a mark upon the foreheads
fish.bot: of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations...
fish.verse: And the LORD said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.

fish.top: ...and I will put a new spirit within you;
fish.bot: and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh...
fish.verse: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:

fish.top: For I am the LORD: I will speak,
fish.bot: and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass...
fish.verse: For I am the LORD: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord GOD.

fish.top: Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols;
fish.bot: and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
fish.verse: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.

fish.top: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant...
fish.bot: ...and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.
fish.verse: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.

fish.top: In the mountain of the height of Israel...
fish.bot: ...bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar...
fish.verse: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.

fish.top: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth...
fish.bot: ...wherefore turn yourselves, and live ye.
fish.verse: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord GOD : wherefore turn yourselves , and live ye.

fish.top: I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign
fish.bot: between me and them... that I am the LORD that sanctify them.
fish.verse: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the LORD that sanctify them.

fish.top: and it shall be no more, until he come
fish.bot: whose right it is; and I will give it him.
fish.verse: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it him.

fish.top: And I sought for a man among them,
fish.bot: that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap...
fish.verse: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.

fish.top: Because thou hast forgotten me,
fish.bot: and cast me behind thy back...
fish.verse: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

fish.top: and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb:
fish.bot: and thou shalt be a sign unto them...
fish.verse: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: and thou shalt be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.

fish.top: and I shall set glory
fish.bot: in the land of the living.
fish.verse: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;

fish.top: ...and shall build houses, and plant vineyards;
fish.bot: yea, they shall dwell with confidence...
fish.verse: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I am the LORD their God.

fish.top: I have made him fair...
fish.bot: so that all the trees of Eden... in the garden of God...
fish.verse: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches: so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied him.

fish.top: Then will I make their waters deep,
fish.bot: and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord GOD.
fish.verse: Then will I make their waters deep, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord GOD.

fish.top: None of his sins that he hath committed
fish.bot: shall be mentioned unto him...he shall surely live.
fish.verse: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.

fish.top: Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep,
fish.bot: and seek them out.
fish.verse: For thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.

fish.top: A new heart also will I give you,
fish.bot: and a new spirit will I put within you...
fish.verse: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.

fish.top: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live,
fish.bot: and I shall place you in your own land...
fish.verse: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the LORD have spoken it , and performed it , saith the LORD .

fish.top: Neither will I hide my face any more from them:
fish.bot: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel...
fish.verse: Neither will I hide my face any more from them: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.

fish.top: behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears,
fish.bot: and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee...
fish.verse: And the man said unto me, Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee; for to the intent that I might shew them unto thee art thou brought hither: declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.

fish.top: it had a wall round about...
fish.bot: to make a separation between the sanctuary...
fish.verse: He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred reeds long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.

fish.top: ...and his voice was like a noise of many waters:
fish.bot: and the earth shined with his glory.
fish.verse: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.

fish.top: And they shall teach my people
fish.bot: the difference between the holy and profane...
fish.verse: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

fish.top: Ye shall have just balances,
fish.bot: and a just ephah, and a just bath.
fish.verse: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.

fish.top: ...whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live:
fish.bot: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish...
fish.verse: And it shall come to pass, that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.

fish.top: But Daniel purposed in his heart
fish.bot: that he would not defile himself...
fish.verse: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king’s meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

fish.top: He revealeth the deep and secret things:
fish.bot: he knoweth what is in the darkness...
fish.verse: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.

fish.top: I see four men... walking in the midst of the fire,
fish.bot: and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.
fish.verse: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.

fish.top: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol
fish.bot: and honour the King of heaven, all whose works are truth...
fish.verse: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven, all whose works are truth, and his ways judgment: and those that walk in pride he is able to abase.

fish.top: and the God in whose hand thy breath is,
fish.bot: and whose are all thy ways, hast thou not glorified...
fish.verse: But hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before thee, and thou, and thy lords, thy wives, and thy concubines, have drunk wine in them; and thou hast praised the gods of silver, and gold, of brass, iron, wood, and stone, which see not, nor hear, nor know: and the God in whose hand thy breath is, and whose are all thy ways, hast thou not glorified:

fish.top: ...but they could find none occasion nor fault;
fish.bot: forasmuch as he was faithful...
fish.verse: Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom; but they could find none occasion nor fault; forasmuch as he was faithful, neither was there any error or fault found in him.

fish.top: his dominion is an everlasting dominion,
fish.bot: which shall not pass away...
fish.verse: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.

fish.top: I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground:
fish.bot: but he touched me, and set me upright.
fish.verse: Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.

fish.top: O man greatly beloved, fear not:
fish.bot: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong.
fish.verse: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.

fish.top: but the people that do know their God
fish.bot: shall be strong, and do exploits.
fish.verse: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.

fish.top: ...they that turn many to righteousness
fish.bot: as the stars for ever and ever.
fish.verse: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.

fish.top: ...if we follow on to know the LORD:
fish.bot: his going forth is prepared as the morning...
fish.verse: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD : his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.

fish.top: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness;
fish.bot: I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree...
fish.verse: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baal-peor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.

fish.top: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy;
fish.bot: ...for it is time to seek the LORD...
fish.verse: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the LORD , till he come and rain righteousness upon you.

fish.top: I will be as the dew unto Israel:
fish.bot: he shall grow as the lily...
fish.verse: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.

fish.top: And I will restore to you
fish.bot: the years that the locust hath eaten...
fish.verse: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.

fish.top: Can two walk together,
fish.bot: except they be agreed?
fish.verse: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?

fish.top: But let judgment run down as waters,
fish.bot: and righteousness as a mighty stream.
fish.verse: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.

fish.top: not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water,
fish.bot: but of hearing the words of the LORD...
fish.verse: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord GOD, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the LORD:

fish.top: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David
fish.bot: that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof...
fish.verse: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:

fish.top: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish
fish.bot: to swallow up Jonah.
fish.verse: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

fish.top: But truly I am full of power
fish.bot: by the spirit of the LORD, and of judgment, and of might...
fish.verse: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the LORD, and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.

fish.top: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good;
fish.bot: ...to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
fish.verse: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

fish.top: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity...
fish.bot: ...he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
fish.verse: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.

fish.top: Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables,
fish.bot: that he may run that readeth it.
fish.verse: And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.

fish.top: Although the fig tree shall not blossom...
fish.bot: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD...
fish.verse: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

fish.top: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save,
fish.bot: he will rejoice over thee with joy...
fish.verse: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.

fish.top: and will make thee as a signet:
fish.bot: for I have chosen thee, saith the LORD of hosts.
fish.verse: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, will I take thee, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, saith the LORD, and will make thee as a signet: for I have chosen thee, saith the LORD of hosts.

fish.top: ...will be unto her a wall of fire round about,
fish.bot: and will be the glory in the midst of her.
fish.verse: For I, saith the LORD , will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.

fish.top: For who hath despised the day of small things?
fish.bot: for they shall rejoice...
fish.verse: For who hath despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of the LORD, which run to and fro through the whole earth. shall rejoice

fish.top: Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour;
fish.bot: execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates...
fish.verse: These are the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:

fish.top: ...behold, thy King cometh unto thee:
fish.bot: he is just, and having salvation; lowly...
fish.verse: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.

fish.top: In that day there shall be a fountain opened
fish.bot: ...for sin and for uncleanness.
fish.verse: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.

fish.top: but it shall come to pass,
fish.bot: that at evening time it shall be light.
fish.verse: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the LORD, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.

fish.top: And he shall sit as a refiner
fish.bot: and purifier of silver...
fish.verse: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the LORD an offering in righteousness.

fish.top: ...thou shalt call his name JESUS:
fish.bot: for he shall save his people from their sins.
fish.verse: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.

fish.top: And he saith unto them, Follow me,
fish.bot: and I will make you fishers of men.
fish.verse: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

fish.top: Let your light so shine before men,
fish.bot: that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father...
fish.verse: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

fish.top: Give us this day
fish.bot: our daily bread.
fish.verse: Give us this day our daily bread.

fish.top: Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him,
fish.bot: saying, I will; be thou clean.
fish.verse: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

fish.top: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me;
fish.bot: ...and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
fish.verse: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.

fish.top: A bruised reed shall he not break,
fish.bot: and smoking flax shall he not quench...
fish.verse: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.

fish.top: when he had found one pearl of great price,
fish.bot: went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
fish.verse: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

fish.top: And immediately Jesus stretched forth
fish.bot: his hand, and caught him...
fish.verse: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?

fish.top: ...and upon this rock I will build my church;
fish.bot: and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
fish.verse: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

fish.top: For where two or three are gathered together
fish.bot: in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
fish.verse: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

fish.top: the Son of man came not to be ministered unto,
fish.bot: but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
fish.verse: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

fish.top: Hosanna to the Son of David:
fish.bot: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord...
fish.verse: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

fish.top: Render therefore unto Cæsar the things...
fish.bot: and unto God the things that are God's.
fish.verse: They say unto him, Cæsar’s. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Cæsar the things which are Cæsar’s; and unto God the things that are God’s.

fish.top: But he that shall endure unto the end,
fish.bot: the same shall be saved.
fish.verse: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

fish.top: Well done, thou good and faithful servant:
fish.bot: ...enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
fish.verse: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

fish.top: O my Father... nevertheless
fish.bot: not as I will, but as thou wilt.
fish.verse: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.

fish.top: And, behold, the veil of the temple
fish.bot: was rent in twain from the top to the bottom...
fish.verse: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;

fish.top: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations,
fish.bot: baptizing them in the name of the Father...
fish.verse: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:

fish.top: For whosoever shall do the will of God,
fish.bot: the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
fish.verse: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.

fish.top: ...and said unto the sea, Peace, be still.
fish.bot: And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
fish.verse: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

fish.top: Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole;
fish.bot: go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
fish.verse: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.

fish.top: Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place,
fish.bot: and rest a while...
fish.verse: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

fish.top: Whosoever will come after me, let him deny
fish.bot: himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
fish.verse: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

fish.top: If thou canst believe,
fish.bot: all things are possible to him that believeth.
fish.verse: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

fish.top: Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God
fish.bot: as a little child, he shall not enter therein.
fish.verse: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.

fish.top: My house shall be called of all nations
fish.bot: the house of prayer...
fish.verse: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.

fish.top: love the Lord thy God with all thy heart,
fish.bot: and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind...
fish.verse: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.

fish.top: And the gospel must first be published
fish.bot: among all nations.
fish.verse: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.

fish.top: Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee;
fish.bot: ...nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
fish.verse: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.

fish.top: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter
fish.bot: that he goeth before you into Galilee...
fish.verse: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.

fish.top: Behold the handmaid of the Lord;
fish.bot: be it unto me according to thy word.
fish.verse: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.

fish.top: For unto you is born this day in the city of David
fish.bot: a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
fish.verse: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

fish.top: He that hath two coats, let him impart
fish.bot: to him that hath none...
fish.verse: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.

fish.top: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me...
fish.bot: to preach deliverance to the captives...
fish.verse: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,

fish.top: Launch out into the deep,
fish.bot: and let down your nets for a draught.
fish.verse: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

fish.top: But love ye your enemies, and do good,
fish.bot: and lend, hoping for nothing again...
fish.verse: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.

fish.top: And stood at his feet behind him weeping,
fish.bot: and began to wash his feet with tears...
fish.verse: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

fish.top: No man, when he hath lighted a candle...
fish.bot: setteth it on a candlestick...
fish.verse: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.

fish.top: If any man will come after me,
fish.bot: let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily...
fish.verse: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

fish.top: The harvest truly is great,
fish.bot: but the labourers are few...
fish.verse: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.

fish.top: Our Father which art in heaven,
fish.bot: Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come.
fish.verse: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.

fish.top: For where your treasure is,
fish.bot: there will your heart be also.
fish.verse: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

fish.top: Strive to enter in
fish.bot: at the strait gate...
fish.verse: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.

fish.top: For this my son was dead, and is alive again;
fish.bot: he was lost, and is found.
fish.verse: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.

fish.top: If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed,
fish.bot: ye might say unto this sycamine tree...
fish.verse: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.

fish.top: ...but smote upon his breast, saying,
fish.bot: God be merciful to me a sinner.
fish.verse: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.

fish.top: For the Son of man is come
fish.bot: to seek and to save that which was lost.
fish.verse: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

fish.top: For he is not a God of the dead,
fish.bot: but of the living: for all live unto him.
fish.verse: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.

fish.top: then look up, and lift up your heads;
fish.bot: for your redemption draweth nigh.
fish.verse: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.

fish.top: I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not:
fish.bot: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
fish.verse: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.

fish.top: Verily I say unto thee, To day
fish.bot: shalt thou be with me in paradise.
fish.verse: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.

fish.top: Did not our heart burn within us,
fish.bot: while he talked with us by the way...
fish.verse: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?

fish.top: ...Behold the Lamb of God,
fish.bot: which taketh away the sin of the world.
fish.verse: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.

fish.top: Verily, verily, I say unto thee,
fish.bot: Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
fish.verse: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

fish.top: the water that I shall give him shall be in him
fish.bot: a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
fish.verse: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

fish.top: Jesus saith unto him,
fish.bot: Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
fish.verse: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.

fish.top: and him that cometh to me
fish.bot: I will in no wise cast out.
fish.verse: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

fish.top: If any man thirst,
fish.bot: let him come unto me, and drink.
fish.verse: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

fish.top: If the Son therefore shall make you free,
fish.bot: ye shall be free indeed.
fish.verse: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

fish.top: ...one thing I know,
fish.bot: that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
fish.verse: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no , I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

fish.top: I am the resurrection, and the life:
fish.bot: he that believeth in me... yet shall he live:
fish.verse: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

fish.top: Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground...
fish.bot: if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
fish.verse: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.

fish.top: In my Father's house are many mansions...
fish.bot: I go to prepare a place for you.
fish.verse: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

fish.top: Abide in me, and I in you.
fish.bot: As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine...
fish.verse: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

fish.top: Sanctify them through thy truth:
fish.bot: thy word is truth.
fish.verse: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.

fish.top: ...he said, It is finished:
fish.bot: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
fish.verse: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

fish.top: Lord, thou knowest all things;
fish.bot: thou knowest that I love thee... Feed my sheep.
fish.verse: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

fish.top: But ye shall receive power,
fish.bot: after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you...
fish.verse: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

fish.top: ...there is none other name under heaven
fish.bot: given among men, whereby we must be saved.
fish.verse: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.

fish.top: Him hath God exalted with his right hand
fish.bot: to be a Prince and a Saviour...
fish.verse: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.

fish.top: being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly
fish.bot: into heaven, and saw the glory of God...
fish.verse: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

fish.top: Then Philip opened his mouth,
fish.bot: ...and preached unto him Jesus.
fish.verse: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.

fish.top: Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus...
fish.bot: hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight...
fish.verse: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.

fish.top: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth
fish.bot: with the Holy Ghost and with power...
fish.verse: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.

fish.top: ...and had seen the grace of God, was glad,
fish.bot: ...that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.
fish.verse: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.

fish.top: I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles,
fish.bot: ...for salvation unto the ends of the earth.
fish.verse: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.

fish.top: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness,
fish.bot: in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven...
fish.verse: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.

fish.top: Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ,
fish.bot: and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
fish.verse: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

fish.top: ...they received the word with all readiness
fish.bot: of mind, and searched the scriptures daily...
fish.verse: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.

fish.top: So mightily grew the word of God
fish.bot: and prevailed.
fish.verse: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.

fish.top: ...the ministry, which I have received
fish.bot: of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.
fish.verse: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.

fish.top: ...we ceased, saying,
fish.bot: The will of the Lord be done.
fish.verse: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.

fish.top: ...arise, and be baptized, and wash away
fish.bot: thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.
fish.verse: And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.

fish.top: ...the Lord stood by him, and said,
fish.bot: Be of good cheer, Paul...
fish.verse: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.

fish.top: To open their eyes, and to turn them
fish.bot: from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan...
fish.verse: To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.

fish.top: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer:
fish.bot: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.
fish.verse: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.

fish.top: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ:
fish.bot: for it is the power of God unto salvation...
fish.verse: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

fish.top: ...not knowing that the goodness of God
fish.bot: leadeth thee to repentance?
fish.verse: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?

fish.top: But where sin abounded,
fish.bot: grace did much more abound.
fish.verse: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:

fish.top: For the wages of sin is death;
fish.bot: but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
fish.verse: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

fish.top: And if children, then heirs;
fish.bot: heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ...
fish.verse: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.

fish.top: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus,
fish.bot: ...thou shalt be saved.
fish.verse: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.

fish.top: And be not conformed to this world:
fish.bot: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind...
fish.verse: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

fish.top: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy
fish.bot: and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope...
fish.verse: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.

fish.top: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God,
fish.bot: and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?
fish.verse: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?

fish.top: For ye are bought with a price:
fish.bot: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit...
fish.verse: For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God’s.

fish.top: Knowledge puffeth up,
fish.bot: but charity edifieth.
fish.verse: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.

fish.top: ...God is faithful... with the temptation also
fish.bot: make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
fish.verse: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.

fish.top: Now ye are the body of Christ,
fish.bot: and members in particular.
fish.verse: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.

fish.top: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three;
fish.bot: but the greatest of these is charity.
fish.verse: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.

fish.top: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory
fish.bot: through our Lord Jesus Christ.
fish.verse: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

fish.top: Who hath also sealed us, and given
fish.bot: the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
fish.verse: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.

fish.top: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels,
fish.bot: that the excellency of the power may be of God...
fish.verse: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.

fish.top: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ,
fish.bot: ...be ye reconciled to God.
fish.verse: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ’s stead, be ye reconciled to God.

fish.top: ...for your sakes he became poor,
fish.bot: that ye through his poverty might be rich.
fish.verse: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.

fish.top: My grace is sufficient for thee:
fish.bot: for my strength is made perfect in weakness.
fish.verse: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

fish.top: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live;
fish.bot: yet not I, but Christ liveth in me...
fish.verse: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

fish.top: For ye are all the children of God
fish.bot: by faith in Christ Jesus.
fish.verse: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.

fish.top: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace,
fish.bot: longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith...
fish.verse: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

fish.top: For by grace are ye saved through faith;
fish.bot: and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God.
fish.verse: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:

fish.top: Put on the whole armour of God,
fish.bot: that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
fish.verse: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

fish.top: For to me to live is Christ,
fish.bot: and to die is gain.
fish.verse: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

fish.top: Rejoice in the Lord alway:
fish.bot: and again I say, Rejoice.
fish.verse: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

fish.top: ...the riches of the glory of this mystery
fish.bot: ...which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
fish.verse: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

fish.top: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily,
fish.bot: as to the Lord, and not unto men;
fish.verse: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

fish.top: ...caught up... to meet the Lord in the air:
fish.bot: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
fish.verse: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

fish.top: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly;
fish.bot: ...your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved...
fish.verse: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

fish.top: ...Christ Jesus came into the world
fish.bot: to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
fish.verse: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

fish.top: But godliness with contentment
fish.bot: is great gain.
fish.verse: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

fish.top: Study to shew thyself approved unto God,
fish.bot: a workman that needeth not to be ashamed...
fish.verse: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

fish.top: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course,
fish.bot: I have kept the faith.
fish.verse: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

fish.top: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower
fish.bot: than the angels... crowned with glory and honour...
fish.verse: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.

fish.top: For the word of God is quick, and powerful,
