fish.bot: and sharper than any twoedged sword...
fish.verse: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

fish.top: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul,
fish.bot: both sure and stedfast...
fish.verse: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;

fish.top: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith
fish.bot: without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
fish.verse: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)

fish.top: But now they desire a better country,
fish.bot: ...for he hath prepared for them a city.
fish.verse: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.

fish.top: ...and let us run with patience
fish.bot: the race that is set before us.
fish.verse: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us , and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

fish.top: But be ye doers of the word,
fish.bot: and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
fish.verse: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

fish.top: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord,
fish.bot: and he shall lift you up.
fish.verse: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.

fish.top: But ye are a chosen generation,
fish.bot: a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people...
fish.verse: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:

fish.top: Casting all your care upon him;
fish.bot: for he careth for you.
fish.verse: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

fish.top: ...he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins,
fish.bot: and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
fish.verse: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

fish.top: ...we have an advocate with the Father,
fish.bot: Jesus Christ the righteous:
fish.verse: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:

fish.top: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world:
fish.bot: and this is the victory... even our faith.
fish.verse: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.

fish.top: I have no greater joy than to hear
fish.bot: that my children walk in truth.
fish.verse: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.

fish.top: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning
fish.bot: and the ending, saith the Lord...
fish.verse: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.

fish.top: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock:
fish.bot: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in...
fish.verse: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

fish.top: ...a great multitude, which no man could number,
fish.bot: of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues...
fish.verse: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;

fish.top: ...the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ;
fish.bot: and he shall reign for ever and ever.
fish.verse: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.

fish.top: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb,
fish.bot: and by the word of their testimony...
fish.verse: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.

fish.top: Great and marvellous are thy works,
fish.bot: Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways...
fish.verse: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.

fish.top: ...Come out of her, my people,
fish.bot: that ye be not partakers of her sins...
fish.verse: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.

fish.top: ...saying, Alleluia:
fish.bot: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.
fish.verse: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.

fish.top: Surely I come quickly. Amen.
fish.bot: Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
fish.verse: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.

fish.top: Moreover he kissed all his brethren,
fish.bot: and wept upon them...
fish.verse: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.

fish.top: ...ye shall be a peculiar treasure
fish.bot: unto me above all people...
fish.verse: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:

fish.top: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the tabernacle
fish.bot: by day, and fire was on it by night...
fish.verse: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

fish.top: ...thou shalt leave them unto the poor,
fish.bot: and to the stranger: I am the LORD your God.
fish.verse: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am the LORD your God.

fish.top: ...and he shall recompense his trespass
fish.bot: with the principal thereof...
fish.verse: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.

fish.top: Let us go up at once, and possess it;
fish.bot: for we are well able to overcome it.
fish.verse: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

fish.top: ...I am thy part and thine inheritance
fish.bot: among the children of Israel.
fish.verse: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.

fish.top: And thou shalt teach them diligently
fish.bot: unto thy children...
fish.verse: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

fish.top: ...that thou mayest obey his voice,
fish.bot: and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he is thy life...
fish.verse: That thou mayest love the LORD thy God, and that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he is thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

fish.top: But the mountain shall be thine;
fish.bot: ...for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites...
fish.verse: But the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.

fish.top: ...Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice,
fish.bot: and to hearken than the fat of rams.
fish.verse: And Samuel said, Hath the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD ? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.

fish.top: ...I will not put forth mine hand
fish.bot: against my lord; for he is the LORD’s anointed.
fish.verse: Behold, this day thine eyes have seen how that the LORD had delivered thee to day into mine hand in the cave: and some bade me kill thee: but mine eye spared thee; and I said, I will not put forth mine hand against my lord; for he is the LORD’s anointed.

fish.top: And David danced before the LORD
fish.bot: with all his might...
fish.verse: And David danced before the LORD with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod.

fish.top: ...for they cried to God in the battle,
fish.bot: ...because they put their trust in him.
fish.verse: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.

fish.top: ...he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee,
fish.bot: until thou hast finished all the work...
fish.verse: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD .

fish.top: ...that should praise the beauty of holiness,
fish.bot: ...Praise the LORD; for his mercy endureth for ever.
fish.verse: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto the LORD , and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the LORD ; for his mercy endureth for ever.

fish.top: Whom I shall see for myself,
fish.bot: and mine eyes shall behold, and not another...
fish.verse: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.

fish.top: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still,
fish.bot: and consider the wondrous works of God.
fish.verse: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

fish.top: And he shall be like a tree
fish.bot: planted by the rivers of water...
fish.verse: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

fish.top: But thou, O LORD,
fish.bot: art a shield for me; my glory...
fish.verse: But thou, O LORD , art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.

fish.top: Thou wilt shew me the path of life:
fish.bot: in thy presence is fulness of joy...
fish.verse: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

fish.top: Shew me thy ways, O LORD;
fish.bot: teach me thy paths.
fish.verse: Shew me thy ways, O LORD ; teach me thy paths.

fish.top: O send out thy light and thy truth:
fish.bot: let them lead me...
fish.verse: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

fish.top: God is our refuge and strength,
fish.bot: a very present help in trouble.
fish.verse: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

fish.top: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness;
fish.bot: and thy paths drop fatness.
fish.verse: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

fish.top: I will praise the name of God with a song,
fish.bot: and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
fish.verse: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

fish.top: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us:
fish.bot: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us...
fish.verse: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

fish.top: He that dwelleth in the secret place
fish.bot: of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
fish.verse: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

fish.top: As far as the east is from the west,
fish.bot: so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
fish.verse: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

fish.top: I will take the cup of salvation,
fish.bot: and call upon the name of the LORD.
fish.verse: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD .

fish.top: They that sow in tears
fish.bot: shall reap in joy.
fish.verse: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

fish.top: But there is forgiveness with thee,
fish.bot: that thou mayest be feared.
fish.verse: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

fish.top: Even there shall thy hand lead me,
fish.bot: and thy right hand shall hold me.
fish.verse: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.

fish.top: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him,
fish.bot: to all that call upon him in truth.
fish.verse: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

fish.top: Hatred stirreth up strifes:
fish.bot: but love covereth all sins.
fish.verse: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.

fish.top: He brought me to the banqueting house,
fish.bot: and his banner over me was love.
fish.verse: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was love.

fish.top: But he was wounded for our transgressions,
fish.bot: ...and with his stripes we are healed.
fish.verse: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

fish.top: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters,
fish.bot: and that spreadeth out her roots by the river...
fish.verse: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.

fish.top: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul;
fish.bot: therefore will I hope in him.
fish.verse: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

fish.top: ...and the house was filled with the cloud,
fish.bot: ...full of the brightness of the LORD’s glory.
fish.verse: Then the glory of the LORD went up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD’s glory.

fish.top: Repent, and turn yourselves...
fish.bot: ...so iniquity shall not be your ruin.
fish.verse: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord GOD . Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.

fish.top: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice;
fish.bot: and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
fish.verse: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

fish.top: I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the LORD,
fish.bot: and he heard me...thou heardest my voice.
fish.verse: And said, I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the LORD , and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, and thou heardest my voice.

fish.top: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city,
fish.bot: wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons...
fish.verse: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?

fish.top: The LORD is good, a strong hold
fish.bot: in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
fish.verse: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.

fish.top: ...I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee,
fish.bot: and I will clothe thee with change of raiment.
fish.verse: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with change of raiment.

fish.top: ...If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed...
fish.bot: ...nothing shall be impossible unto you.
fish.verse: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

fish.top: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said.
fish.bot: Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
fish.verse: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

fish.top: And let us not be weary in well doing:
fish.bot: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
fish.verse: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

fish.top: But the Lord is faithful,
fish.bot: who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
fish.verse: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.

fish.top: For there is one God, and one mediator
fish.bot: between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
fish.verse: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

fish.top: How much more shall the blood of Christ...
fish.bot: purge your conscience... to serve the living God?
fish.verse: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

fish.top: And above all things have fervent charity
fish.bot: ...for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
fish.verse: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

fish.top: Worthy is the Lamb that was slain
fish.bot: to receive power, and riches, and wisdom...
fish.verse: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.

fish.top: And whosoever will,
fish.bot: let him take the water of life freely.
fish.verse: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
